mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) AND deleted = 0

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.gender, u.birthday, u.presence_status AS presenceStatus, r.role_code AS roleCode, l.label AS label, l.color AS labelColor FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN family_user_label l ON l.user_id = u.id AND l.family_id = #{familyId} WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND ur.family_id = #{familyId} AND r.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY u.id
SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id WHERE ur.family_id = #{familyId} AND u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id WHERE ur.family_id = #{familyId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
